blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is “terribly excited” about the United States-led Pax Silica initiative in Pampanga. The chief executive sees the project as an opportunity for the Philippines to expand its role in the global semiconductor industry. He believes Pax Silica will take the country beyond manufacturing and into research, design and development.
